name: @intellectual-frontiers/desired-os-state
description: Desired OS State in the layers of Kanon: what a server, a device, a workstation or a cloud account must be, said once as requirements, the order and the plan made from them, and the port that a package for each tool (Ansible, OpenTofu, Microsoft DSC) implements; assurance profiles match the approval of a change to the fleet.

scripts.verify: tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun ../tools/mizan-check.ts --root spec-kit && bun ../libraries/src/check.ts --root spec-kit --level L1 && bun ../kanon/src/check.ts && bun tools/check.ts && bun test ./suite/ && bun tools/pack.ts --check
